Redis._AllowInMemoryFallback_comment: spaarke-redis-cache-remediation-r1 task 002 (FR-03, ADR-009 amendment): Opt-in to in-memory cache fallback when Enabled=false. Defaults to false so deployed environments fail fast at startup rather than silently degrading. The CacheModule env-guard only honors this flag in the Development environment when Enabled=false; in Staging/Production it throws regardless. Leave false in all deployed environment configs.

Dataverse._ClientSecret_comment: DEPRECATED (AUTHV2-042 Phase C): All BFF Dataverse service-context flows now use DefaultAzureCredential (App Service managed identity). Setting is retained as a no-op for backward compatibility; safe to remove from Key Vault after deploy verification. Operator action required before deploy: App Service MI (PrincipalId 56ae2188-c978-4734-ad16-0bc288973f20) must be configured as a Dataverse Application User in BOTH spaarkedev1 + spaarke-demo environments with the security roles previously held by the BFF app registration.

Graph._ManagedIdentity_comment: Task 041 (Phase C): When Enabled=true, GraphClientFactory.CreateAppOnlyClient() uses DefaultAzureCredential (App Service managed identity) instead of ClientSecretCredential. DefaultAzureCredential chains through dev credentials (EnvironmentCredential, AzureCliCredential, VisualStudioCredential, etc.) so local dev still works without code changes (run `az login`). Set ClientId only when using User-Assigned MI; leave null for system-assigned MI. OBO flow (per-user) is unaffected — still uses API_CLIENT_SECRET via ConfidentialClientApplication. Per-tenant container-type configs in SpeAdminGraphService also unaffected (they use per-customer app reg secrets from Key Vault). Operator action required before deploy with Enabled=true: grant the App Service MI service principal the same Microsoft Graph application permissions previously granted to the BFF app registration (FileStorageContainer.Selected, Files.Read.All, etc.).

Spaarke._Graph_TodoSync_comment: smart-todo-decoupling-r3 Phase 6 (task 018): Feature gate for the Microsoft Graph /me/todo sync layer. When Enabled=false (default), the BFF binds Null-Object impls of ITodoGraphSyncHandler / ISpaarkeListProvisioner / ITodoSubscriptionManager / ITodoSyncBackfiller (ADR-032 P2 quiet semantics) and no Graph traffic flows for todo sync. Phase 7 (tasks 061/062/063/065) adds the real impls. Until D-1 (Tasks.ReadWrite scope), D-4 (Modern UCI app id), and D-5 (Service Bus 'todosync' queue) are all confirmed in the target environment, ship with Enabled=false. Real impls require the Graph subscription manager extension + Service Bus job pipeline; see project design.md §6.
Spaarke._Environment_comment: smart-todo-decoupling-r3 Phase 7 (task 060, FR-25): Modern UCI host (org base URL) used by DeepLinkBuilder to populate Graph linkedResources[0].webUrl. Environment-specific; NO hardcoded value in source. Example: https://spaarkedev1.crm.dynamics.com. Placeholder values are intentional — replace per environment via deploy-time token substitution.
Spaarke._ModelDrivenApps_comment: smart-todo-decoupling-r3 Phase 7 (task 060, FR-25, D-4, UQ-2): Canonical Modern UCI app id (GUID) hosting the sprk_todo form. Environment-specific — coordinate with environment owner. NO hardcoded value in source. Example: 0a1b2c3d-4e5f-6789-abcd-ef0123456789.

ScheduledRagIndexing._comment: Periodic catch-up indexing for documents that were not indexed on upload. Submits bulk indexing jobs.

Email._WebhookSigningKey_comment: Task 044: HMAC-SHA256 signing key for /api/v1/emails/webhook-trigger. Must match the secret configured on the Dataverse Service Endpoint (HttpHeader or WebKey auth). Rotate on incident or every 90 days. Filter is fail-closed.

AiSearch._AllowedIndexes_comment: Multi-container-multi-index-r1 (Phase B, FR-BFF-06): allow-list of physical AI Search index names that callers may target via the per-record / per-request searchIndexName parameter on IKnowledgeDeploymentService.GetSearchClientAsync. Requests specifying an indexName NOT in this list MUST be rejected by the resolver with ProblemDetails 400 + stable error code INDEX_NOT_ALLOWED (ADR-019 + NFR-08). Empty array means no caller-supplied indexes accepted (the 2-tier Dataverse → appsettings fallback still applies when indexName is omitted).

AiSafety._ContentSafety_comment: Safety perimeter (AIPU2-020/021): Azure AI Content Safety resource used by PromptShieldService (text:shieldPrompt) + GroundednessCheckService (text:detectGroundedness) via the named 'ContentSafety' HttpClient. AUTH (assessment rec 3, ADR-028): ContentSafetyAuthHandler selects managed-identity bearer auth (DefaultAzureCredential, pinned to Graph:ManagedIdentity:ClientId when set) when ManagedIdentity:Enabled=true OR when ApiKey is absent; otherwise it sends the Ocp-Apim-Subscription-Key. Keep ApiKey for local dev (or run 'az login' and omit it). Operator action REQUIRED before setting Enabled=true in any environment: grant the App Service managed identity the 'Cognitive Services User' role on the Content Safety resource — without it every scan fails open (watch ai.safety.shield_evaluations / scripts/kql/ai-metering/shield-coverage.kql after the flip).

PromptShield._ChatPipelineEnabled_comment: F-8 (audit finding follow-up): wires PromptShieldChatMiddleware onto the LIVE interactive chat pipeline — a PRE-LLM prompt-injection perimeter (hard block on detection) PLUS the per-turn fail-open verdict that feeds the confirmation gate's overlay-2 (SafetyPerimeterDegraded → gated WRITES require confirmation; reads/drafts stay fail-open). DEFAULT false = feature OFF = byte-identical to today (no scan, no block, gate probe unfed). Set true ONLY AFTER the AiSafety:ContentSafety endpoint + auth are configured AND the App Service managed identity holds 'Cognitive Services User' on the Content Safety resource (same grant as the ContentSafety comment above) — otherwise every scan fails OPEN and every gated WRITE degrades to confirm-required (safe direction, but noisy; watch ai.safety.shield_evaluations outcome=failed_open_*). Adds up to ~100ms pre-first-token latency per turn (PromptShieldService hard deadline; NO new timeout is introduced).

AzureOpenAI._classificationModelComment: AIPU2-004: Dedicated Layer 2 classification deployment (capability routing, safety pre-checks, feedback triage, session summarization). Isolated 30K-TPM quota. Set to 'gpt-4o-mini' to fall back to the shared deployment if spaarke-gpt4o-mini is not provisioned.

Communication._WebhookSigningKey_comment: Task 044: HMAC-SHA256 signing key for /api/communications/incoming-webhook (X-Hub-Signature-256 header). Used when a signing relay (Logic App / Function / APIM) sits in front of the endpoint and signs Graph notifications on Graph's behalf, since Graph itself does not sign bodies. Together with the in-body clientState check, this provides defense-in-depth. Rotate on incident or every 90 days. Filter is fail-closed.
Communication._AutoFile_comment: Task 015 (FR-11 / ADR-018): Association-Engine auto-file kill-switch. 'Enabled'=true auto-files DETERMINISTIC (rungs 0-3) matches at/above 'Threshold' to Resolved; false downgrades them to Suggested (suggest-only) with no redeploy (read via IOptionsMonitor). AI rungs (4-5) NEVER auto-file regardless. 'Threshold' (default 0.85) is tunable up (conservative) or down (aggressive auto-routing). 'Tenants' optionally overrides Enabled/Threshold per opaque tenant key on multi-tenant deployments; omit for single-org. ADR Tension Path A owner override of design DEC-4 — misfile is re-file (audited), never delete.
Communication._SemanticMatch_comment: Task 030 (FR-14): Association-Engine rung 4 (semantic record match over spaarke-records-index via the IRecordMatchingAi facade). 'Enabled'=true (default) runs the rung when the deterministic rungs (0-3) did not auto-file; false makes it a no-op with no redeploy. Rung 4 NEVER auto-files (mapper-enforced) — its candidates surface as Suggested. 'ScoreCeiling' (0.80) keeps semantic confidence below the 0.85 auto-file threshold; 'MinScore' (0.50) drops weak hits; 'Limit'/'MaxCandidates' bound the search fan-out and emitted candidates.

Webhook._SigningKey_comment: FR-26 (task 053): HMAC-SHA256 signing key for /api/compose/webhooks/spe-doc-changed (return-from-Word SPE change notifications). Fail-closed filter mirroring CommunicationEndpoints; paired with the in-body ClientState constant-time check (defense-in-depth). Rotate on incident or every 90 days. DEV provisions these as direct App Service settings (Compose__Webhook__SigningKey / __ClientState / __NotificationUrl, provisioned 2026-07-10 per DEF-03 / issue #602); PROD uses these Key Vault references (secrets: compose-webhook-signingkey / compose-webhook-clientstate).

Finance._InvoiceExtractionPlaybookId_comment: chat-routing-redesign-r1 Q1 follow-up fix (2026-06-22). Stable opaque ID (sprk_playbookid, GUID-format mirroring the row's sprk_analysisplaybookid PK) for the Finance Invoice Processing playbook (sprk_playbookcode PB-013). Resolved at runtime via IPlaybookLookupService.GetByIdAsync per Q1 + ADR-018. Formerly the literal slug 'PB-013' was embedded in InvoiceExtractionJobHandler.cs; under the Q1 refactor the lookup column changed (sprk_playbookcode → sprk_playbookid) and the slug became invalid. DEV-environment value: 1e657651-9308-f111-8407-7c1e520aa4df. Populated per-env at deploy time; empty string causes the job handler to mark the invoice Failed and return Success.

_routing_config_removed_comment: FR-P3-01 (spaarke-ai-architecture-redesign-r1 task 040, 2026-07-06): the LinearConsumers block, the Workspace playbook-id keys, and the Insights Playbooks Map block were DELETED under the ADR-039 single-routing-surface rule (NFR-08 hard cutover — no config fallback exists). ALL consumer-to-playbook/action routing is declared in the sprk_playbookconsumer Dataverse table; the Insights canonical playbook names live in sprk_consumercode on 'insights-ask' rows (seed mirrors: infra/dataverse/sprk_playbookconsumer-insights-rows.json).
